description: Source code implementing WebSocket stream adapters for SPDY and QUIC protocols, including classes for handling socket operations, stream delegation, and data transfer management within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for handling WebSocket client socket operations, wrapping a ClientSocketHandle.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing SPDY stream operations for WebSocket, including reading, writing, and delegate handling.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing QUIC stream operations for WebSocket, including reading, header writing, and delegate handling.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket or stream into the provided buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from the buffer to the socket or stream.

methods.name: is_initialized
methods.description: Returns whether the stream or socket is initialized.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles reception of headers in the stream.
